criteria.text: States that the lock-up expires on 5 June 2027 (365 days after the 5 June 2026 Prospectus date).
Identifies that 15% of 16,000,000 Firm Shares is 2,400,000 shares, not the 3,200,000 stated in the Over-allotment Option (Clause 4).
Identifies that the comfort letter cut-off of 24 May 2026 is 12 days before the 5 June 2026 pricing date, outside the 3-business-day requirement in Clause 7(b), so a bring-down letter is needed.
Identifies the inconsistency between 61,750,000 shares in issue in the Prospectus and 63,000,000 in the Underwriting Agreement recital, which must be reconciled before pricing.
Gives the lock-up as a duration (365 days) and a date (5 June 2027), with days remaining from 4 May 2026 (397 days).
Notes that 5 June 2027 is a Saturday and identifies the next Business Day, 7 June 2027, as the first trading opportunity.
Opens with a short 'Bottom line' / executive summary stating the overall conclusion and the most important risks before the detailed analysis.
